firstPlayerRule: Give the start player token to the player who most recently ate bacon.
clarifications: The start player begins the first round, and the next player clockwise follows.

For later rounds, pass the start player token to the player on the team with the fewest total victory points who is closest clockwise to the previous start player. If tied, pass it to the next player clockwise.
